Findings: Supersedes warning 01KY05J9H1V3X2Z1R55N958GE1: external tester Lanny Ripple was reached through internal Slack (Dave, 2026-07-20), so the Gmail sent-mail absence did not mean no enrollment. Lesson: Gmail is not the only comms channel — don't infer non-contact from its absence.
